actions.label: Restore the document view
actions.caption: esc clears the Results overlay. Return to the table associated with the structure selection.

actions.label: Visit the next hit
actions.caption: n moves to the next matching name. Compare the same field across different JSON records.

actions.label: Return to the previous hit
actions.caption: n moves forward first; N returns to the previous match. Revisit a result without rerunning the search.

notes.note: e opens the file chooser; ctrl+o shows our recent sample files.
Reset point: every action begins here again; earlier actions never change this starting state.
